name: Chitose Yuzuru
source:
1st year student.
Star Sign: Taurus

A 1st year student at Hoshinomori Private Magical Arts High School, his major is cello.
He's always starting fights and even when he's quiet he gives off an imposing aura, but he can be sensitive and gets fired up whenever it concerns playing cello.
He's known [url=/c53459]Kanato[/url] since middle school, and it seems they used to hang out a lot back then.
